Man-up warehouse employee - Amsterdam -  €16.16 per uur - Logistics - 38.75 hour Do you enjoy performing a variety of tasks in a warehouse with different responsibilities? As a Man-Up Employee, you are the link between the order pickers, inventory, and the packing department within the outbound process. Once all products have been sorted from the containers, any remaining stock is collected into individual boxes and placed on pallets. These pallets are moved to the storage area, where you use a man-up truck, also known as a Very Narrow Aisle (VNA) truck, to place the individual boxes in the correct storage locations. The storage racks are specifically designed to hold individual boxes rather than full pallets. This means you will actively move around the warehouse and place each box in the correct location. Your responsibilities: - Process and place stock boxes into the storage racks. - Pick and replenish boxes when stock is running low or empty in the picking department. - Use a scanner to register every box and ensure that all inventory movements are correctly recorded in the system. - Make sure products are stored accurately and efficiently. - Work closely with the order picking and packing teams to ensure a smooth outbound process. Because we hold the contracts with the carriers, we are responsible for that support. As logistics support specialist, you are the link between our clients, our packing department and carriers such as DHL, DPD and UPS. You investigate, liaise with everyone involved and make sure every case is properly closed. You can start right away, or later by agreement. Tasks and responsibilities: - You handle the daily emails from clients about short deliveries and missing boxes - For each case, you work with the carrier (DHL, DPD or UPS) to find out what happened - You check with the packing department how a shipment was processed and sent - You keep the client informed about the progress and the outcome - You work closely with the packing department supervisor - Where needed, you take on other tasks on the warehouse floor  About Hartevelt Hartevelt Fashion Fulfilment is a family business that started in 1945 as a dry cleaner in Zeist.
